summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, to announce a routine listing upgrade of its common shares from the Nasdaq Capital Market to the Nasdaq Global Select Market, and to disclose management participation in upcoming investor conferences.
